title: Off to the Station Platform  (Indo Para a Plataforma da Estação)

segments.t: Às duas e meia, sob o arco de pedra do portão que dá para a rua, Hannah entrega a Caleb e a Owen um cartaz de boas-vindas de cartolina cor de creme decorado com uma rosa dos ventos de oito pontas. Ouçam primeiro a cena toda.
Here is your station sign, gentlemen: Welcome Back to Room Eight and Room Nine!
Look, Owen — Hannah even drew that exact eight-point compass rose in the corner!
Platform three arrives in twenty minutes, little brother, and the station walk takes twelve.
Will he even remember me from a crowded university lecture hall ten years ago?
Are you kidding, Caleb? You recognized his tiny ink star inside one second!
Besides, teachers never forget the quiet student who measures every room in his notebook.
Help carry his suitcase from the platform and take a station taxi straight back here!
Did Arthur manage to invite the neighbors down Linden Street for half past three?
Sixteen neighbors already replied yes, and number ten is tuning his violin right now!
Save two seats near the piano for us — come on, Caleb, eyes forward and no shortcuts!
Definitely zero Arthur alleys today — straight down Linden Street to Central Station!
Ring the gate bell twice when your taxi pulls up at three!
Retomamos agora essa partida para a estação fala por fala.
Here is your station sign, gentlemen: Welcome Back to Room Eight and Room Nine!
'Aqui está o cartaz de vocês para a estação, cavalheiros: "Bem-vindos de volta aos quartos oito e nove!"'
Look, Owen — Hannah even drew that exact eight-point compass rose in the corner!
'Olhe, Owen — Hannah até desenhou a exata rosa dos ventos de oito pontas no canto!'
Platform three arrives in twenty minutes, little brother, and the station walk takes twelve.
'O trem da plataforma três chega em vinte minutos, irmãozinho, e o trajeto a pé para a estação leva doze.'
Will he even remember me from a crowded university lecture hall ten years ago?
'Ela sequer vai se lembrar de mim depois de uma sala de aula universitária lotada de dez anos atrás?'
Are you kidding, Caleb? You recognized his tiny ink star inside one second!
'Está brincando, Caleb? Você reconheceu sua minúscula estrela de tinta em menos de um segundo!'
Besides, teachers never forget the quiet student who measures every room in his notebook.
'Além disso, professores nunca esquecem do estudante quieto que mede cada sala no seu caderno.'
Help carry his suitcase from the platform and take a station taxi straight back here!
'Ajude-o a carregar a mala da plataforma e peguem um táxi da estação para voltar direto para cá!'
Did Arthur manage to invite the neighbors down Linden Street for half past three?
'O Arthur conseguiu convidar os vizinhos da Rua das Tílias para as três e meia?'
Sixteen neighbors already replied yes, and number ten is tuning his violin right now!
'Dezesseis vizinhos já responderam que sim, e o número dez está afinando o violino neste exato instante!'
Save two seats near the piano for us — come on, Caleb, eyes forward and no shortcuts!
'Guardem dois lugares para nós perto do piano — vamos lá, Caleb, olhe reto para a frente e nada de atalhos!'
Definitely zero Arthur alleys today — straight down Linden Street to Central Station!
'Absolutamente zero becos estilo Arthur hoje — direto pela Rua das Tílias até a estação central!'
Ring the gate bell twice when your taxi pulls up at three!
'Toquem a campainha do portão duas vezes quando o táxi de vocês encostar aí na frente às três!'
Vamos ouvir toda a cena novamente em velocidade natural.
Here is your station sign, gentlemen: Welcome Back to Room Eight and Room Nine!
Look, Owen — Hannah even drew that exact eight-point compass rose in the corner!
Platform three arrives in twenty minutes, little brother, and the station walk takes twelve.

Are you kidding, Caleb? You recognized his tiny ink star inside one second!
Besides, teachers never forget the quiet student who measures every room in his notebook.
Help carry his suitcase from the platform and take a station taxi straight back here!
Did Arthur manage to invite the neighbors down Linden Street for half past three?
Sixteen neighbors already replied yes, and number ten is tuning his violin right now!
Save two seats near the piano for us — come on, Caleb, eyes forward and no shortcuts!
Definitely zero Arthur alleys today — straight down Linden Street to Central Station!
Ring the gate bell twice when your taxi pulls up at three!

Os dois irmãos descem a Rua das Tílias a passos largos, lado a lado, em direção à estação central, enquanto a Pousada Pátio das Tílias prepara a mais calorosa das boas-vindas. E agora a cena final do quinto episódio!
See you at three!
